$comment: The founding town. Coordinates are meters; 'door' is where the building meets the street. Locations with construction_project stay closed until that project completes.

locations.name: The Lexington, Apt 1204
locations.description: A corner one-bedroom on the twelfth floor of the town's first luxury tower. Floor-to-ceiling windows over the construction cranes.

locations.name: Maple Court, Unit 3B
locations.description: A starter apartment in the first finished block of Maple Court. Thin walls, good light, and the smell of fresh paint.

locations.name: Maple Court, Unit 2A
locations.description: A starter one-bedroom in Maple Court's first finished block. Bare walls, good light, room to make it yours.

locations.name: Maple Court, Unit 2B
locations.description: A starter one-bedroom in Maple Court's first finished block. Bare walls, good light, room to make it yours.

locations.name: Maple Court, Unit 4A
locations.description: A starter one-bedroom in Maple Court's first finished block. Bare walls, good light, room to make it yours.

locations.name: Maple Court, Unit 4C
locations.description: A starter one-bedroom in Maple Court's first finished block. Bare walls, good light, room to make it yours.

locations.name: The Lexington, Apt 0807
locations.description: A one-bedroom in the town's first luxury tower, with a view of the cranes.

locations.name: The Lexington, Apt 1502
locations.description: A one-bedroom in the town's first luxury tower, with a view of the cranes.

locations.name: James Wellness
locations.description: Harper James's therapy and wellness studio: warm lamps, deep leather chairs, a yoga room upstairs.

locations.name: Low End Studios
locations.description: Andre Campbell's recording studio: a vintage console, a wall of synths, and a couch that has heard every demo in town. Listening sessions most nights.

locations.name: Ellis Atelier
locations.description: Naomi Ellis's atelier and showroom: mood boards, black-and-white lookbooks, and one rail of finished pieces.

locations.name: Whitaker Capital
locations.description: The consortium's Livéra office: glass, walnut, and a model of the city as it will look in ten years.

locations.name: Common Ground Community Center
locations.description: Maya Bennett's nonprofit: a community center for the people building Livéra. Free dinners, tutoring, a legal clinic on Thursdays.

locations.name: Parallax Labs
locations.description: Julian Park's startup, building AI that plans cities, with Livéra as its first customer. Standing desks, a whiteboard wall, cold brew on tap.

locations.name: The Livéra Ledger
locations.description: The town's newspaper: four desks, a police scanner, and Leila Rahal's corkboard of red string.

locations.name: Baptiste & Co. Events
locations.description: Aaliyah Baptiste's event agency: swatches, seating charts, and the guest list for every opening in town.

locations.name: Lumen Creative
locations.description: The agency branding Livéra itself. Sienna Brooks runs the creative floor.

locations.name: The Lexington, Apt 1801
locations.description: A corner one-bedroom with a dress form by the window and fabric swatches on every surface.

locations.name: The Lexington, Penthouse
locations.description: The top floor: three bedrooms, a terrace over the river, and very little furniture yet.

locations.name: The Lexington, Apt 0904
locations.description: Fresh flowers every Monday, a closet sorted by colour, and a calendar booked solid.

locations.name: Maple Court, Unit 1A
locations.description: A ground-floor one-bedroom, two blocks from Common Ground. The door is never locked for long.

locations.name: Riverside Lofts, Unit 2
locations.description: An open loft with a keyboard in the kitchen and a view of where ÉCLAT is going up.

locations.name: Riverside Lofts, Unit 3
locations.description: A loft of concrete, linen and one perfect lamp.

locations.name: Riverside Lofts, Unit 5
locations.description: A loft with three monitors, a pull-up bar and an unopened box of plates.

locations.name: 3 Founders Row
locations.description: A brick townhouse full of plants, books and mismatched armchairs.

locations.name: 7 Founders Row
locations.description: A narrow townhouse with blackout curtains and a desk buried in files.

locations.name: Heritage Coffee Co.
locations.description: Exposed brick, a long communal table, and the only espresso machine in town. Everyone ends up here. Open mic any time the café is open.

locations.name: Greenleaf Market
locations.description: The town's grocery store, still half-stocked while the distribution road is being paved.

locations.name: Meridian Talent Partners
locations.description: A recruiting firm's new Livéra office, hiring for every employer that's moving to town.

locations.name: Forge Builders Site Office
locations.description: Two stacked trailers, a plan table, and a whiteboard of every build in town.

locations.name: Riverdale Clinic
locations.description: A walk-in clinic that will become Riverdale Medical Center once the town grows.

offers.label: Treatment for what the doctor found

locations.name: Greater Hope Missionary Baptist Church
locations.description: The first congregation in Livéra. Sunday service, a choir, and a kitchen that feeds whoever shows up.

locations.name: Founders Park
locations.description: A small green with new saplings, a fountain that isn't switched on yet, and a view of the river.

locations.name: Livéra Police Station
locations.description: Livéra Police Department: a front desk, three holding cells, and the academy classroom in back.

locations.name: Station 1 Fire & Rescue
locations.description: Landmark only for now: civic services arrive in a later milestone (see docs/ROADMAP.md).

locations.name: Founders Way (unpaved)
locations.description: The dirt road that will become the town's main boulevard. Graders and a paving crew.

locations.name: Maple Court Phase II site
locations.description: Framing for 120 new apartments. Cranes, lumber stacks, and a temporary fence.

locations.name: Body & Balance (construction)
locations.description: A gym going up next to the park.

locations.name: Parcel 7 (future nightlife)
locations.description: An empty riverside parcel waiting for Founders Way to be paved before work can start.

locations.name: Maple Court Phase II
locations.description: 120 new apartments. Leasing opens with the economy milestone.

locations.name: Body & Balance
locations.description: Free weights, a spin room, and a smoothie bar.

locations.name: ÉCLAT
locations.description: Velvet rope, a riverside terrace, and the loudest sound system for two hundred miles.

locations.name: Thread & Co.
locations.description: Racks of everyday clothes, a mirror wall, and a sale bin by the door.

locations.name: Circuit Electronics
locations.description: Demo laptops chained to white tables, a wall of headphones, and a guy who really wants to talk about specs.

locations.name: Riverdale Pharmacy
locations.description: Fluorescent aisles, a prescription counter in the back, and a pharmacist who remembers everyone's name.

locations.name: Lustre Jewelers
locations.description: Glass cases, soft lighting, and a velvet tray brought out only when they think you're serious.

locations.name: Fade & Glow Salon
locations.description: Three barber chairs, two stylists, a nail station, and a playlist nobody is allowed to change.

offers.label: Hot towel shave or beard trim

locations.name: Livéra University
locations.description: A new campus on the river: one finished lecture hall, a library that smells of fresh paint, and a law clinic upstairs.

locations.name: Livéra General Hospital
locations.description: Emergency room open around the clock, a maternity ward, and a parking lot still mostly gravel.

offers.label: Treatment for what the doctor found

locations.name: Hale & Partners
locations.description: Livéra's first law firm: glass conference room, a library of statute books nobody reads, and a partner who bills in six-minute increments.

locations.name: The Copper Tap
locations.description: A long copper bar, a dartboard nobody hits, and a corner stage for whoever's brave enough.

locations.name: The Underpass
locations.description: Under the half-built overpass by the Forge yard. After dark, someone is always there selling something.

locations.name: Founders School
locations.description: Kindergarten through twelfth grade in one long brick building, with a gym that doubles as the auditorium.

locations.name: Little Sprouts Daycare
locations.description: A bright daycare for babies and toddlers. The office upstairs also places nannies with families.
